__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Select Prometheus datasource scraping NGINX Plus exporter

description: Enterprise-grade Grafana dashboard for NGINX Plus Prometheus Exporter monitoring HTTP traffic, Stream (TCP/UDP), SSL/TLS, Rate Limiting, Connection Limiting, Slab Memory, Worker processes, and Go runtime telemetry.

links.title: NGINX Plus API Reference
links.tooltip: Open official NGINX Plus API Docs

panels.title: Config Generation & Version
panels.description: Total NGINX configuration reloads, build version info, or exporter active state.

panels.title: Total HTTP Request Rate
panels.description: Global client HTTP request throughput handled by NGINX Plus.

panels.title: Total Stream Connection Rate
panels.description: Global L4 TCP/UDP connection throughput across all stream server zones.

panels.title: Active Client Connections
panels.description: Total number of active client connections currently established.

panels.title: In-Flight Processing (HTTP & Stream)
panels.description: Concurrent HTTP requests and Stream sessions actively being processed.

panels.title: License Expiration
panels.description: Time remaining until NGINX Plus subscription license expires.

panels.title: Worker Crashes & License Reporting
panels.description: Abnormally terminated & respawned workers (crashes), and license reporting health state.

panels.title: Global HTTP Request Rate
panels.description: Total client HTTP requests per second partitioned by instance.

panels.title: Client Connections Breakdown (Accepted, Active, Idle, Dropped)
panels.description: Rate of accepted and dropped client connections alongside current active and idle connections.

panels.title: Worker Process Request Distribution
panels.description: Verifies that incoming traffic is evenly balanced across NGINX worker processes (PID & ID).

targets.expr: sum by (id, pid) (rate(nginxplus_worker_http_requests_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (id) (rate(nginxplus_workers_http_requests{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Worker Concurrency & Connection States
panels.description: Per-worker breakdown of active, idle, and accepted connections.

targets.expr: sum by (id) (nginxplus_worker_connection_active{instance=~"$instance"}) or sum by (id) (nginxplus_workers_connections{instance=~"$instance", connections="active"})
sum by (id) (nginxplus_worker_connection_idle{instance=~"$instance"}) or sum by (id) (nginxplus_workers_connections{instance=~"$instance", connections="idle"})

panels.title: Worker & Process Memory Footprint
panels.description: Physical resident memory (RSS), virtual/private memory, and Go runtime allocations.

panels.title: HTTP Server Zones (Frontend Endpoints & Virtual Hosts)
Request Rate by Server Zone
panels.description: Incoming HTTP requests per second partitioned by HTTP server zone / virtual host.

panels.title: HTTP Status Code Classes by Server Zone
panels.description: HTTP response codes categorized into classes (1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx) across server zones.

panels.title: HTTP Network Bandwidth (Received vs Sent)
panels.description: Network traffic volume received from clients vs transmitted back per server zone.

panels.title: HTTP Error Codes (4xx & 5xx Spikes)
panels.description: Specific client error and server error codes (e.g. 400, 403, 404, 500, 502, 503, 504).

panels.title: HTTP Server Zones Performance Matrix
panels.description: Detailed operational summary matrix across all active HTTP server zones.

targets.expr: sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_server_zone_processing{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_server_zone_requests{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}))

sum by (server_zone) (rate(nginxplus_server_zone_discarded{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_server_zone_requests{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}))

sum by (server_zone) (rate(nginxplus_server_zone_received{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_server_zone_requests{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}))

sum by (server_zone) (rate(nginxplus_server_zone_sent{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_server_zone_requests{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$server_zone"}))

panels.title: HTTP Backend Server Status & Health Check State
panels.description: Live health status, active connections, and fail counts for all HTTP upstream servers (supports UP, DRAINING, DOWN, UNAVAIL, CHECKING, UNHEALTHY).

panels.title: HTTP Backend Request Rate by Server
panels.description: Load distribution across individual upstream backend servers.

panels.title: HTTP Upstream Latency Percentiles (P50, P90, P99)
panels.description: Upstream response latency percentiles (P50, P90, P99) if histogram buckets are exposed, with automatic fallback to Max, Avg, Min response times and Header TTFB from nginx-prometheus-exporter.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, upstream) (rate(nginxplus_upstream_server_response_time_hist_bucket{instance=~"$instance", upstream=~"$upstream", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 1000) or max by (upstream) (nginxplus_upstream_server_response_time{instance=~"$instance", upstream=~"$upstream", server=~"$server"})

(histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, upstream) (rate(nginxplus_upstream_server_response_time_hist_bucket{instance=~"$instance", upstream=~"$upstream", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 1000) or avg by (upstream) (nginxplus_upstream_server_response_time{instance=~"$instance", upstream=~"$upstream", server=~"$server"})

(histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, upstream) (rate(nginxplus_upstream_server_response_time_hist_bucket{instance=~"$instance", upstream=~"$upstream", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 1000) or avg by (upstream) (nginxplus_upstream_server_header_time{instance=~"$instance", upstream=~"$upstream", server=~"$server"})

panels.title: HTTP Response Time vs Header TTFB Time
panels.description: Average time to receive first response header (TTFB) vs total upstream response completion time.

panels.title: HTTP Health Check Probes & Failures
panels.description: Active synthetic health checks executed and failures detected per backend server.

panels.title: HTTP Upstream Bandwidth Throughput
panels.description: Data sent to and received from upstream backend servers.

panels.title: HTTP Upstream Keepalive Pools & Zombie Backends
panels.description: Idle keepalive connections maintained with backends, and zombie servers being drained after reload.

panels.title: HTTP Upstream Response Codes (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx)
panels.description: Status codes returned directly by upstream backend servers.

panels.title: Stream Server Zones (L4 TCP/UDP Frontend Proxies)
Stream Connections Rate by Zone
panels.description: Incoming TCP/UDP connections per second across stream server zones.

panels.title: Stream Sessions Completed by Status Code
panels.description: Completed L4 TCP/UDP sessions categorized by status code classes (2xx success, 4xx client errors, 5xx backend errors).

panels.title: Stream Bandwidth Throughput (Received vs Sent)
panels.description: Network traffic volume received from stream clients vs transmitted back per stream server zone.

panels.title: Stream Active Processing & Discarded Connections
panels.description: Active in-flight stream connections alongside discarded connections per zone.

panels.title: Stream Server Zones Performance Matrix
panels.description: Comprehensive summary table for L4 TCP/UDP stream server zones.

targets.expr: sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_stream_server_zone_processing{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_stream_server_zone_connections{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}))

sum by (server_zone) (rate(nginxplus_stream_server_zone_discarded{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_stream_server_zone_connections{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}))

sum by (server_zone) (rate(nginxplus_stream_server_zone_received{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_stream_server_zone_connections{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}))

sum by (server_zone) (rate(nginxplus_stream_server_zone_sent{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (server_zone) (nginxplus_stream_server_zone_connections{instance=~"$instance", server_zone=~"$stream_server_zone"}))

panels.title: Stream Backend Server Status & Availability Matrix
panels.description: Live health status, active connections, and fail counts for all Stream upstream backend targets (supports UP, DRAINING, DOWN, UNAVAIL, CHECKING, UNHEALTHY).

panels.title: Stream Forwarded Connections Rate by Server
panels.description: L4 connections forwarded per second to each stream backend target.

panels.title: Stream Latency: Connect Time, First Byte, Response Time
panels.description: TCP connection establishment time, first byte received, and full session response time in milliseconds.

panels.title: Stream Upstream Bandwidth Throughput
panels.description: Data sent to and received from stream backend targets per second.

panels.title: Stream Health Check Probes & Failures
panels.description: Active synthetic TCP/UDP health checks executed and failures detected per stream backend.

panels.title: Stream Active Connections, Zombies & Unavailability
panels.description: Active in-flight TCP/UDP connections per server, zombie servers being drained, and unavailability events.

panels.title: SSL/TLS Handshake Rate & Session Reuses (Global)
panels.description: Total SSL handshakes completed and session resumption rate (caching/tickets).

panels.title: SSL Handshakes & Reuses by Server Zone (HTTP & Stream)
panels.description: SSL negotiation activity broken down per frontend virtual host and Stream TCP/UDP proxy.

panels.title: SSL Handshake Failure Root Causes
panels.description: SSL negotiation errors categorized by protocol mismatch, cipher incompatibility, timeout, or peer rejection.

panels.title: Client Certificate Verification Failures (mTLS / Client Auth)
panels.description: Mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificate verification failures categorized by error type.

panels.title: Traffic Rate Limiting & Connection Limiting (limit_req & limit_conn)
HTTP Rate Limiting Dynamics (limit_req)
panels.description: Traffic rate limiting dynamics showing passed, delayed (burst queue), and rejected (burst exceeded) requests per limit zone.

panels.title: Connection Limiting Dynamics (limit_conn)
panels.description: Concurrent client connection limiting dynamics showing passed and rejected connections per limit_conn zone.

panels.title: Rate & Connection Limiting Operational Matrix
panels.description: Per-zone audit table for traffic shaping, rate limits, and concurrency limiting enforcement.

targets.expr: sum by (zone) (rate(nginxplus_limit_request_delayed{instance=~"$instance", zone=~"$zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (zone) (nginxplus_limit_request_passed{instance=~"$instance", zone=~"$zone"}))

sum by (zone) (rate(nginxplus_limit_request_rejected{instance=~"$instance", zone=~"$zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (zone) (nginxplus_limit_request_passed{instance=~"$instance", zone=~"$zone"}))

sum by (zone) (rate(nginxplus_limit_connection_rejected{instance=~"$instance", zone=~"$zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (zone) (nginxplus_limit_connection_passed{instance=~"$instance", zone=~"$zone"}))

panels.title: Shared Memory Zones & Process Memory (Slab Allocator)
Shared Memory Zone Slab Page Usage (%) & Process Memory
panels.description: Percentage of allocated memory pages currently used in each shared memory zone (via NJS/API) or NGINX Process RSS vs Virtual Memory footprint (via nginx-prometheus-exporter).

panels.title: Slab Allocation Failures & Saturation Alerts
panels.description: Failed memory allocation attempts inside shared memory zones (indicates zone size needs to be increased). Defaults to 0 baseline when scraped via nginx-prometheus-exporter.

targets.expr: sum by (zone, slot) (rate(nginxplus_slab_fails{instance=~"$instance", zone=~"$zone"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (instance) (process_resident_memory_bytes{instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Shared Memory Zone Operations & Slab Request Rate
panels.description: Shared memory zone request rate and slot allocation attempts (8B to 2048B) or limit zone operational rates from nginx-prometheus-exporter.

panels.title: Process Memory Footprint & Slab Slot Allocation
panels.description: Process Resident Set Size (RSS) physical memory and virtual memory from nginx-prometheus-exporter, alongside slab slot counts when available.

panels.title: Exporter Scrape Status & Health
panels.description: NGINX Plus Prometheus exporter scrape target health, scrape request rate, and build info.

panels.title: Exporter Process CPU & System Resources
panels.description: CPU core utilization and resident/virtual memory footprint of the exporter process.

panels.title: Go Goroutines, Threads & Open File Descriptors
panels.description: Active Go runtime goroutines, operating system threads, and open file descriptors.

panels.title: Go GC Pause Latency & Allocations Rate
panels.description: Garbage collection stop-the-world pause quantiles (P50, Max) and heap allocation rate.

title: NGINX Plus - Observability & Traffic Overview
